extension.summary: A clock whose digits crumble into falling sand every time they change
extension.description: A big clock that crumbles into sand. Every second (or every minute) the digits that change break into hundreds of grains that fall under gravity and slide into a heap at the bottom of the screen, which slowly sinks through the floor so the sand never runs out of room. Each change can bring a new colour, so the pile builds up in layers. In the settings you can pick the font (nine, from Inter to pixel, dot matrix and stencil) and its weight, whether only the changing digits crumble or the whole clock, the colours (eight palettes, one colour of your own or a slow rainbow), different colours at night, the grain size and look (sand, flat or round beads), gravity, the crumble speed, how tall the pile gets, dimming and a slow drift that protects OLED screens.
